{{Top|leg}}
The '''Service for the Departed''' was a traditional [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]] for an individual who had [[Death/Legends|died]]. It took approximately two hours to complete. [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] provided this service to [[Marcopius]], when he died.
